{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Merino turtleneck, fitted with a slim cut, hip length, charcoal grey #4A4F57, fine merino wool
Trousers, straight high-waisted cut, full length to the ankle bone, deep navy #1F2A44, wool-blend flannel with a soft brushed finish
Textured blazer, relaxed single-breasted cut, hip length, heathered grey-brown #6B645C, wool tweed with a lining
Long coat, straight cut with a insulated lining, mid-calf length, dark camel #8A6A4A, double-faced wool with a down-fill quilted interior
Ankle boots, flat with a lugged rubber sole, round toe, ankle height, black #1A1A1A, waterproof leather with a warm fleece lining
Scarf, wide and oversized, long, burgundy #6D1F2F, soft lambswool
Knit beanie, snug fit with a folded cuff, burgundy #6D1F2F, wool with a fleece lining
Gloves, classic cut, wrist length, black #1A1A1A, leather with a cashmere lining
Tote bag, structured, medium size, black #1A1A1A, grained leather that resists salt and snow

This outfit keeps the neat office look of a turtleneck, tailored trousers and a textured blazer, while the layers hold in warmth on a long walk in deep frost. The flat boots with a grippy rubber sole and a waterproof finish handle snow and road salt with no heel at all. The long insulated coat covers the legs and the wind-exposed areas, and the scarf, beanie and gloves protect the places that feel the cold most. The muted navy, grey and camel with a burgundy accent look polished at the desk and stay coordinated once the coat comes off."}
